phrases.english: What time is it, please?
I’m running late, sorry.
It’s a quarter past eight.
It’s almost ten o’clock.
We’ll meet at seven sharp.
Where is the checkout counter, please?
How much is this, exactly?
Can I try this on, please?
I only want one piece.
Do you have it in small size?
It’s sunny today, enjoy the day.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟକିରଣ ଅଛି, ଦିନଟା ଉପଭୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji surjya-kiran achhi, dinata upabhoga karantu.

phrases.english: Clouds are gathering, it might rain.
The rain is light, don’t worry.
It’s raining now, take an umbrella.
The wind is strong today, be careful.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ପବନ ବେଶ ଜୋର, ସାବଧାନ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji paban besh jor, sabadhaana ruhantu.

phrases.english: I practice daily, slowly, and keep going.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରେ, ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ, ଆଉ ଚାଲୁ ରଖେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ pratidina abhyaasa kare, dhire dhire, aau chalu rakhe.

phrases.english: Today, I will try again, no worries.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି, ମୁଁ ପୁନି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି, ଚିନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji, muṁ puni chesta karibi, chinta nahin.

phrases.english: I’m improving, one small step at a time.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଉନ୍ନତି କରୁଛି, ପ୍ରତିଥର ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ unnati karuchhi, pratyekathara gotie chhota padakhepare.

phrases.english: Keep breathing, and speak with confidence.
Mistakes help me learn, so relax.
phrases.odia: ଭୁଲମାନେ ମୋତେ ଶିଖାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଆରାମ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Bhulumane mote shikha‘e, tena au aaram kar.

phrases.english: A cow is eating grass, slowly.
The cat wants to come inside, please.
Look at the dog, it’s wagging.
That bird is singing outside, loudly.
The frog is jumping near the pond.
I love this song, it’s so catchy.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହି ଗୀତଟାକୁ ଭଲପାଏ, ବହୁତ ଆକର୍ଷକ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu ehi geetataaku bhala paaye, bahuta aakarshaka.

phrases.english: Play it again, please.
That rhythm feels amazing.
Turn the volume up a little.
Turn it down, it’s too loud.
I need a smaller EMI this month.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଏହି ମାସରେ ଛୋଟ EMI ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: Mo ei masare chhota EMI darkar.

phrases.english: Please check my bank balance now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ମୋ ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟାଲାନ୍ସ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari bartaman mo bank balance janch kar.

phrases.english: Did my salary get credited today, please?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଦରମା ଆସିଛି କି, ଦୟାକରି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo dhrama asichi ki, dayakari?

phrases.english: I want to open a savings account.
The ATM declined my card again.
phrases.odia: ଏହି ATM ଆଉଥରେ ମୋ କାର୍ଡ ଅସ୍ଵୀକାର କରିଲା।
phrases.transliteration: Ei ATM autehare mo card aswikar karila.

phrases.english: I love you, my heart.
You make me feel safe, always.
I miss you, please come back.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ତୁମକୁ ମିସ୍ କରୁଛି, ଦୟାକରି ଫେରିଆସ।
phrases.transliteration: Muṁ tumaku mis karuchi, dayakari feriās.

phrases.english: Stay with me, just tonight.
Your smile is my favorite thing.
Thank you for your kindness, really.
I truly appreciate your help today.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ଆପଣଙ୍କ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଖୁବ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji apananka sahajya paain mu sebu aabari.

phrases.english: Thanks, you made my day better.
phrases.odia: ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ, ଆପଣ ମୋ ଦିନଟା ଭଲ କରିଦେଲେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dhanyabad, apana mo dinata bhala karidele.

phrases.english: I’m grateful for everything you do.
phrases.odia: ଆପଣ କରୁଥିବା ସବୁକିଛି ପାଇଁ ମୁଁ ଆଭାରୀ।
phrases.transliteration: Apana karuthiba sabukichhi paain mu aabari.

phrases.english: Thank you for listening to me.
I will improve, day by day,
Stay calm, even when things change,
I can learn from every mistake,
Small steps, big progress, you know,
Today, I choose to do my best,
I can face this, step by step.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଏହାକୁ ସାମ୍ନା କରିପାରିବି, ପଦେ ପଦେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mu eha ku saamna karipaaribi, pade pade.

phrases.english: Take a deep breath, you’ve got this.
Don’t be afraid, speak up now.
I’ll try again, even if it’s hard.
phrases.odia: କଠିନ ହେଲେମଧ୍ୟ, ମୁଁ ପୁଣି ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବି।
phrases.transliteration: Kathiina helamadhya, mu puni chesta karibi.

phrases.english: Be brave, small steps still count.
phrases.odia: ସାହସ କର, ଛୋଟ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗଣିଯାଏ।
phrases.transliteration: Sahasa kara, chhota padakhepa madhya gani jaae.

phrases.english: I breathe in, and I feel calm.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନେଉଛି, ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଶାନ୍ତ ଲାଗୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mũ shwasa neuchi, aau mũ shaanta laguchhi.

phrases.english: In silence, my heart settles down.
Let go now, everything is okay.
phrases.odia: ଏବେ ଛାଡ଼ି ଦେଅ, ସବୁ ଠିକ ଅଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Ebe chhadi deau, sabu thik achhi.

phrases.english: I choose peace, not worry.
My mind feels lighter, one moment.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ମନ ହାଲୁକା ଲାଗୁଛି, ଏକ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତ।
phrases.transliteration: Mo mana haluka laguchhi, eka muhurtta.

phrases.english: I study Odia every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତିଦିନ ସକାଳେ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ପଢ଼ୁଛି, ଧୀରେ।
phrases.transliteration: Mū pratidina sakālE oḍia paḍhuchi, dheire.

phrases.english: Can you explain this lesson, please?
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari ehi pāṭaṭi bujhāi pāribe ki?

phrases.english: I don’t understand this word, yet.
phrases.transliteration: Ehi shabdaṭa mū ejābat bujhi pāruni.

phrases.english: Please speak a little more slowly.
What does this sentence mean, in Odia?
What festivals are you celebrating this month?
Today, we all meet at the temple.
People here share food with neighbors.
phrases.odia: ଏଠାର ଲୋକମାନେ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ସହ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବାଣ୍ଟନ୍ତି।
phrases.transliteration: Ethaara lokamanen padośiṅka saha khaadya baṇṭanti.

phrases.english: Do you drink tea after morning prayers?
phrases.odia: ସକାଳ ପୂଜା ପରେ ଆପଣ ଚାହା ପିଅନ୍ତି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Sakaal pooja pare apana chaaha pibhanti ki?

phrases.english: We greet elders with folded hands.
phrases.odia: ଆମେ ବୟସ୍କମାନଙ୍କୁ ହାତ ଯୋଡ଼ି ଶୁଭେଚ୍ଛା ଦେଉ।
phrases.transliteration: Ame bayaskamananku haata joḍi shubhechchha deu.

phrases.english: Hello, how are you today?
Hi there, good to see you!
Good morning, have a nice day!
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସକାଳ, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ ଭଲ ହେଉ!
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sakala, apankara dina bhala heau!

phrases.english: Good afternoon, hope you’re doing well.
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ଦୁପୁର, ଆପଣ ଭଲ ଥାନ୍ତୁ ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରୁଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Shubha dupura, apan bhala thantu boli asha karuchhi.

phrases.english: Good evening, how’s your day going?
phrases.odia: ଶୁଭ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା, ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦିନ କେମିତି ଚାଲୁଛି?
phrases.transliteration: Shubha sandhya, apankara dina kemiti chaluchhi?

phrases.english: I can do this, step by step.
Stay strong, you’re not alone here.
phrases.odia: ଦୃଢ଼ ରୁହ, ତୁମେ ଏଠାରେ ଏକା ନୁହଁ।
phrases.transliteration: Drudha rōha, tume ehāre eka nuha.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again.
phrases.odia: ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତାପରେ ଆଉଥରେ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Shwāsa nīa, tāpare āuthare chesta kara.

phrases.english: I’ve got this, don’t worry.
Keep going, even when it’s hard.
My purpose is to help others, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସଦା ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କୁ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା।
phrases.transliteration: Mo uddeshya sada anyamananku sahajya kariba.

phrases.english: I want to learn Odia, every day.
My purpose today is simple, just work.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସରଳ, କେବଳ କାମ।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo uddeshya sarala, kebala kaam.

phrases.english: I’m here to try, not to quit.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେବା ପାଇଁ ନୁହେଁ, ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବାକୁ ଆସିଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu chhadideba pain nuhen, chesta karibaku asichhi.

phrases.english: My purpose is peace, and kindness.
Inhale slowly, feel the room around you.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ନିଅ, ତୁମ ଚାରିପଟେ ଅନୁଭବ କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas ni’o, tuma charipate anubhaba kara.

phrases.english: Exhale gently, relax your shoulders now.
phrases.odia: ଧୀରେ ଶ୍ୱାସ ଛାଡ଼, ଏବେ ତୁମ ଦେହ ଶିଥିଲା କର।
phrases.transliteration: Dhire shwas chhād’o, ebe tuma deha shitilā kara.

phrases.english: Feel your feet, grounded and steady.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ପାଦକୁ ଅନୁଭବ କର, ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ଦୃଢ଼।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma padaku anubhaba kara, bhala bhabare dr̥iḍha.

phrases.english: Let your breath be your guide.
phrases.odia: ତୁମ ଶ୍ୱାସକୁ ନିଜର ପଥପ୍ରଦର୍ଶକ ହେବାକୁ ଦିଅ।
phrases.transliteration: Tuma shwasaku nijara pathapradarshaka hebāku di’o.

phrases.english: Right now, be present with me.
phrases.odia: ଏଇ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତରେ, ମୋ ସହିତ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ରୁହ।
phrases.transliteration: Ei muhurtta re, mo sahita upasthita ruh.

phrases.english: I drink warm water every morning, slowly.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ପ୍ରତି ସକାଳେ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଗୁନା ପାଣି ପିଉଛି।
phrases.transliteration: Mu prti sakale dhire dhire guna pani pijuchi.

phrases.english: Please wash your hands before eating, now.
phrases.odia: ଦୟାକରି ଖାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ହାତ ଧୁଅ, ଏବେ।
phrases.transliteration: Dayakari khaiaba purbaru hata dhu, ebe.

phrases.english: Do you have any headache today?
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ତୁମର କିଛି ମୁଣ୍ଡବିଥା ଅଛି କି?
phrases.transliteration: Aji tumara kichhi mundabitha achhi ki?

phrases.english: I feel better after rest, thank you.
phrases.odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ପରେ ମୋତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗୁଛି, ଧନ୍ୟବାଦ।
phrases.transliteration: Bishram pare mote bhal laguchhi, dhanyabad.

phrases.english: Let’s walk outside for ten minutes.
My wife makes our home happy, always.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ସ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଆମ ଘରକୁ ସଦା ଖୁସି କରେ।
phrases.transliteration: mo stri amara gharaku sada khusi kare

phrases.english: I miss my brother, we should talk.
phrases.odia: ମୋ ଭାଇକୁ ମୁଁ ଭଲେ ପାଏ, କଥା ହେବା ଦରକାର।
phrases.transliteration: mo bhai ku mu bhale pae, katha heba darkar

phrases.english: My friend always listens, thank you.
Your father is kind, I can tell.
I love my sister, she understands me.
phrases.odia: ମୁଁ ମୋ ଭଉଣୀକୁ ଭଲ ପାଏ, ସେ ମୋତେ ବୁଝେ।
phrases.transliteration: mu mo bhouṇiki ku bhala pae, se mote bujhe

phrases.english: I feel happy today, really happy.
phrases.odia: ଆଜି ମୋ ମନ ଖୁସି, ବହୁତ ଖୁସି।
phrases.transliteration: Aji mo mana khusi, bahuta khusi.

phrases.english: A warm smile makes me happy.
I’m grateful, and I feel light.
My heart is calm right now.
Good news always makes me smile.
